summary: Grupo Televisa, S.A.B. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its third-quarter 2026 earnings release and IFRS interim financial statements for the period ended September 30, 2026. Revenue fell 3.8% year over year to Ps.14,077.7 million, while operating segment income rose 5.6% to Ps.5,996.0 million, a 42.6% margin. Net income attributable to stockholders was Ps.882.7 million versus a Ps.1,932.5 million loss a year earlier, helped by lower finance expense and taxes. Cable and Sky are now reported as one Telecom segment. No transaction, board recommendation, or deal mechanics are present; no risk-arb angle applies.
